what: What am I looking at? add_view_summary()
title: The components
text: panel summarises features view compares whole map. Options: stat: "mean" (default), "median" "sum". "sum" suits absolute values, population, shows share total view: “16.8M, 36% total”. Values million abbreviated. weight: column weight mean median, population. compact = TRUE: count, value comparison. collapsed: button corner collapses panel title value. maps narrower 480 px, phones, panel starts collapsed; collapsed = FALSE keeps open collapsible = FALSE removes button. color: one color histogram instead map’s colors.
code: japan |>   add_view_summary(     layer_id = "prefectures",     column = "aged_65",     label = "Aged 65 and over",     name_column = "prefecture",     weight = "pop_2024",     weight_label = "population",     unit = "prefectures",     suffix = "%"   )

title: How it works
text: polygon counts view part screen; point, point screen. Features outside layer’s zoom range counted. Relying map drawn, MapLibre’s queryRenderedFeatures(), enough: features small drawn low zoom missed; globe projection, features far center missed, features far side globe can returned visible. maplore combines : feature view drawn geometric test finds screen, globe features visible side count. points, geometric test alone used. counts checked sf pixel positions several zoom levels, rotation pitch. layer filter, features drawn screen counted, since geometric test apply filter. small features may missed low zoom.

title: How it works
text: Updating takes milliseconds hundreds polygons thousand points. 50,000 points, summary ranking together take 20 ms screen still update panning; searching takes 2 ms. update takes longer 25 ms (around 200,000 points), components update map stops moving, panning stays smooth. Several components layer share work finding features view.

title: How it works
text: One numeric column per component. layer’s source must sf object inline GeoJSON; vector tile sources supported. Shiny proxies compare() widgets supported yet.

what: If you use Mapbox, your token is exposed
title: MapLibre, Mapbox, security and privacy
text: map made mapboxgl() includes Mapbox token HTML, without maplore: browser needs load map, anyone opens page can find . Mapbox designs public tokens , someone use spend quota. publish Mapbox maps: use public token (pk.…), never secret one (sk.…); create separate token published maps, default public token restricted, restrict site’s URLs Mapbox account; keep tokens .Renviron, version control. avoid tokens altogether, use maplibre() free basemap. See Mapbox’s guide using Mapbox securely.
